title: Implement the Stage 1 send-path counterfactual library
summary: Add the common four-axis evidence spine and seam-local force, observe, shadow, latch, safety, outcome, replay, and rollback paths for the Stage 1 adaptive-runtime send-path axes.
planned_changes: Retain the existing send-turn force and shadow streams while adapting them into the common Stage 1 snapshot; add the versioned unified raw and curated epoch schemas, separate decision schemas, semantic validation, and a connection-local accumulator that represents all four axes without inventing missing operations; add application_send_batch_formation legacy_current and single_eligible selection at the packet-plan boundary; add queued_send_burst_budget legacy_current and single_datagram selection as a lower-only actor-turn cap; formalize oversized_write_admission_quantum with legacy_current, single_fragment, and bounded_multi_fragment values latched for one logical write; expose internal forcing, observe-only, shadow recommendation, bounded reasons, safety overrides, attributable outcomes, deterministic replay, and force-legacy rollback for every axis; emit the unified epoch and detailed axis events from the permanent raw QUIC host; and update permanent local and ProtocolLab campaign inputs only after the four-axis runtime emission path is correctness-green.
verification_plan: Build before testing. Add requirement-home tests for the common four-axis contract and each axis value, boundary, latch, transition, fallback, safety override, terminal path, cancellation, disposal, FIN, reset, shutdown, recovery, congestion, pacing, flow-control, ownership, queue, buffer, and rollback invariant. Add bounded property sequences and focused manual or nightly BenchmarkDotNet checks outside correctness CI. Run focused correctness tests after each axis slice and the complete correctness-only Release suite before a small permanent unified smoke. Validate exactly four axis records, exactly one varied treatment, adjacent legacy_current values, forced and applied joins, shadow neutrality, checksums, exclusions, and append-only classifications. Proceed to Stage 2 before any large campaign, dataset transform, or offline ML analysis.
out_of_scope: Production thresholds or a policy winner
Online learning, bandits, reinforcement learning, exploration, self-updating thresholds, runtime model training, or model-file deployment
A large Stage 1 campaign, normalized dataset transform, or offline ML analysis before Stage 2 begins
Factorial multi-axis treatment variation without a separate reviewed plan
Reclassification, deletion, relabeling, or silent combination of negative, failed, invalid, diagnostic, excluded, or partial evidence
